name: XML Formatter
description: Format, minify and validate XML, and query elements, attributes and namespaces with XPath 1.0.
help: Works with well-formed XML, SVG and XHTML; comments, CDATA, declarations, DOCTYPE and processing instructions are kept.
Validation checks tag pairs, unclosed elements, multiple roots and text outside the root, and points to the line and column.
Formatting removes insignificant whitespace between elements; text content is left unchanged.

XPath parses the original text, preserving whitespace and mixed content, with the document root as context. Unprefixed names only match elements without a namespace; bind an explicit prefix for a default XML namespace.

Results distinguish node-sets, strings, numbers and booleans. Numbers use XPath 1.0 floating-point semantics. Q{URI} names describe logical locations, not executable XPath 1.0. Fragments are reserialized, not original source excerpts.

Queries reject DTDs and external entities, variables, id()/lang() and XPath 2/3 extensions. No external resources are accessed. All 13 axes and the listed core functions are supported; see the query page.

Limits: 512 KiB XML, 8000 nodes/attributes, XML depth 64, 2048-byte expressions, expression depth 32 and 4 MiB complete results. Evaluation has a 2-million-work/3-second budget and supports cancellation. Limits fail explicitly. Paged previews mark truncation; copy full values up to 256 KiB or export the full report.

errors.xml.multiple_roots: A second root element starts on line {{line}}
errors.xml.text_outside_root: Text on line {{line}} is outside the root element
errors.xml.no_root: The document has no root element
errors.xpath.limit: Query resource limit exceeded ({{limit}}). No complete result was produced; reduce the document or query.
errors.xpath.dtd: XPath queries do not support DTDs or external entities.
errors.xpath.page_invalid: Invalid query page or result index.
errors.xpath.no_fragment: This result has no serializable XML fragment; copy its value.
errors.xpath.expired: The result has expired; run the query again.
errors.xpath.export_failed: Failed to generate the query report.

xpath.namespaceHint: Bind a query prefix for a default XML namespace. URIs match exactly; queries start at the document root.
xpath.empty: Enter XML and an expression, then query
xpath.emptyHint: Queries read the original document without formatting it first.
xpath.scalarHint: Scalars retain their result type. Numbers use XPath 1.0 floating-point semantics; NaN and Infinity are preserved as text.
xpath.truncated: Preview only; copy the full value or export larger content.
xpath.zero: The expression succeeded and matched 0 nodes.
xpath.support: XPath 1.0 · 13 axes; count/string/boolean/number, position, name, string and numeric core functions. id()/lang(), variables, DTDs and extension functions are unsupported.
